VAR DaysRemaining =
    DATEDIFF(
        TODAY(),
        dim_contracts[contract_end],
        DAY
    )
RETURN
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    ISBLANK(dim_contracts[contract_end]), "Unknown",
    DaysRemaining < 0, "Expired",
    DaysRemaining <= 90, "0–90 Days",
    DaysRemaining <= 180, "91–180 Days",
    DaysRemaining <= 365, "181–365 Days",
    "Over 365 Days"
)

VAR EndDate = dim_contracts[contract_end]
VAR DaysRemaining =
    DATEDIFF(TODAY(), EndDate, DAY)
RETURN
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    ISBLANK(EndDate), 5,
    DaysRemaining < 0, 0,
    DaysRemaining <= 90, 1,
    DaysRemaining <= 180, 2,
    DaysRemaining <= 365, 3,
    4
)

VAR DaysLate = fact_jobs[days_late]
RETURN
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    fact_jobs[is_completed] <> 1, BLANK(),
    ISBLANK(DaysLate), BLANK(),
    DaysLate <= 0, "On Time",
    DaysLate <= 2, "1–2 days",
    DaysLate <= 7, "3–7 days",
    DaysLate <= 14, "8–14 days",
    "15+ days"
)

SWITCH(
    fact_jobs[Delay Severity],
    "On Time", 0,
    "1–2 days", 1,
    "3–7 days", 2,
    "8–14 days", 3,
    "15+ days", 4,
    BLANK()
)
